scenarios.expected: Test connection succeeds; Load models, search and refresh list the provider's models without saving; Field prompts save on Enter, keep line breaks with Shift+Enter, restore the saved text when cleared, and reset to default; an Analysis run sends the target text to the provider and records Version, model, evidence and Unverified values; refusals and the disabled connector behave as documented; the connector ends enabled. Model accuracy is not claimed.
scenarios.actual: A01 to A16 passed on 3fa407e3 (walkthrough-c43.json round 2). AI analysis is its own Organization link; cards were Provider > Request conversion > Field prompts, Field prompts last with no collapse control, the three switches off. Provider showed OpenRouter and deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash with a blank key input and the keep/rotate hint. Test connection showed "Connection successful." in 1.8 s. Load models with the stored key returned 444 models in 229 ms and the button became Refresh models; Search models "deepseek-v4.1" left the one matching model; the selection and updatedAt did not change and no save was sent. Enter saved an edited notice-period prompt (asking for the days stated in the paper, without inference) and showed Reset to default; Shift+Enter inserted a line break; clearing the prompt and leaving restored the saved text; maxlength is 2000. Uploading the fictional paper to C-36 started an automatic run without anyone selecting Run analysis; it finished ready on Version 1 with deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash in 24 s (21.6 s at the provider; walkthrough-c43-attempt1.json A07). The card read "Completed Sep 16, 2026, 7:30 PM on Version 1 with deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash." with Term type, Effective date, Expiry date, Notice period (days) and Value Written and Unverified, Renewal period Invalid, Counterparty Unmatched, and a Price review Key date. A deliberate rerun after the prompt edit showed Running… and finished in 8 to 14 s. The Notice period evidence sparkle opened the doc panel on doc029-live-analysis.docx v1 with "by giving 45 days' written notice" highlighted and made no AI call. On C-37, Run analysis was refused: "This Contract has no primary Document to analyze." (409). Turning Use AI analysis off showed Turned off, disabled Test connection and the three switches, hid Run analysis, kept the Unverified values, and a run request answered 409 "No enabled AI connector is configured."; the stored preset, model and key stayed. A Legal Team Member saw no Run analysis while off, was sent to /settings/profile, and got 403 for the connector and prompt APIs. Turning it on passed Test connection again, and the member saw Run analysis again. Load models against a Custom endpoint with a fictional key and a missing path showed "The provider refused model discovery with HTTP 404." and nothing was saved. Reset to default restored the notice-period prompt; the connector ended enabled with no overridden prompt.

scenarios.actual: OB02 passed. Signed out, the operator opened /documentation/configure-analysis in the formal reader and followed its deployment configuration link to /documentation/deployment-configuration. That page says to allow outbound provider traffic from both the app and worker, and its "Preserve and rotate encryption keys" section says OPENLAW_SECRET_KEY encrypts the AI-provider key. The reader serves the committed article bytes of 3fa407e3, so this proves the operator link and its target, not the reviewed wording. Operator container actions are in operator-observations.json.

scenarios.expected: Both the app and worker reach the AI provider, share the credential encryption key, and do not log the API key.
scenarios.actual: O01, O02, O04 and O05 passed. The app and worker set the same non-empty OPENLAW_SECRET_KEY (compared by hash equality; no value or hash printed) and no AI credential is an environment variable. The app reached OpenRouter for Test connection and Load models. The worker reached OpenRouter: its log has "contract analysis finished" for each run (15:30:01Z, 15:30:18Z, 15:32:39Z, and later runs on C-38), and each run finished ready with the configured model. No proxy variable is set. The logs contain no 'sk-or-' or bearer text. Source inspection confirms that Load models and the probe run in the app, extraction runs in the worker, and the switch changes only disabledAt.

notes.text: Escape in a Field prompt saved the discarded text (A06, both rounds). The handler reverts the draft and then blurs the input, and the blur handler saves the stale draft (apps/web/src/components/ai-field-prompts-card.tsx). The agent restored the prompt with Reset to default. The author removed the Escape sentence from the article, so this is not a scenario failure.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study. Model accuracy is not claimed.

The walkthrough ran against article bytes that still had the sentence "Escape restores the saved text." The author then removed only that sentence (issue #887), which gives the recorded hash a2e55ab5.... The removal takes a claim away and adds no step, so the walkthrough still covers every step in these bytes.

Invalid key, invalid model and provider refusal were not tested live, because the user's key cannot be re-entered without the user. The live failure cases were a Load models refusal (HTTP 404) against a missing endpoint path with a fictional key (not saved), the no-primary-Document refusal, and the disabled connector.
Catalog Fields with AI prompts, Request conversion switches and the other presets were not exercised live. The switches were only seen off and disabled while the connector was off.

Side effects on the lab: a re-run of the reviewer script uploaded a second, non-primary copy of doc029-live-analysis.docx to C-36. The signing paper on C-38 and its executed copy were also sent to OpenRouter by automatic runs, because the connector was enabled.

Reviewer script errors are kept in walkthrough-c43-attempt1.json: A08 read no result rows and A10 found no evidence button because of wrong locators. Round 2 corrected both. The automatic-run observation comes from round 1 A07, because round 2 reused C-36.
The connector ended enabled with OpenRouter and deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash, the key stored, and no prompt overridden.
